title: [FancyZones] Windows don't change size/position when changing layout in multi-monitor mode
author: SeraphimaZykova
summary: FancyZones does not resize or reposition windows after a layout change when zones are allowed to span monitors, while the same operation works with spanning disabled.
next_action: Reproduce layout-change migration in spanning and per-monitor modes on the current release.

confidence.rationale: The setting-based isolation is strong, but the current internal failure point is unproven.

judgment.rationale: The report isolates one setting as the control variable and was split from the broader issue 18679, which was closed after this focused report was created.
evidence: With span-across-monitors enabled, windows do not snap to the new layout.
With the setting disabled, the same layout change resizes/repositions windows.
The issue is assigned to a FancyZones maintainer.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce layout-change migration in spanning and per-monitor modes on the current release.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report is suitable for maintainer reproduction, but the current failing code branch is not proven well enough for a fix plan.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones does not resize or reposition windows after a layout change when zones are allowed to span monitors, while the same operation works with spanning disabled.
known_information: The symptom is specific to layout changes, not initial snapping.
inferences: The spanning desktop identifier or zone-history remap may not receive the same layout-change update path as per-monitor layouts.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is suitable for direct maintainer reproduction and does not need more reporter evidence before that pass.
initial_investigation: Read the focused report and checked parent issue 18679, which is closed.
Confirmed current FancyZones still has Layout and AppZoneHistory components for layout and assignment state.

actions.label: Reproduce spanning-layout migration
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Compare layout changes with zones spanning monitors on and off
setup: Place windows into a known layout.
Prepare a second visibly different layout.
steps: Enable zones spanning monitors and switch layouts.
Record whether assigned windows move and resize.
Disable spanning and repeat with the same windows and layouts.
Compare AppZoneHistory and desktop/layout identifiers in logs.
reproduce.expected_result: Assigned windows should move to the corresponding zones after a layout change in both modes.
